briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ +0.2%, S&P 500 -0.2%), a neutral session with no clear directional catalyst. Rather than force capital into mediocre setups, we deployed a portion of idle cash into two stocks (BRZE, ACMR) that cleared the full four-signal bar — RSI, MACD, SMA-20 trend, and volume surge all aligned — leaving one slot open for a stronger risk-on day. Existing positions were left untouched since none triggered stop-loss or profit-target rules.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Technical confluence means multiple independent indicators — like RSI, MACD, moving averages, and volume — all pointing the same direction at once. When four signals line up together, it's much more likely real buyers are stepping in, rather than the stock just having a random one-day bounce.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 技術指標共振（Technical Confluence）指多個獨立指標——例如RSI、MACD、移動平均線及成交量——同時指向同一方向。當四個訊號一致出現時，代表真正有買盤進場的機會較高，而不只是股價隨機反彈一日。

market_education.summary_en: Today's market action was essentially a coin-flip between the NASDAQ (+0.2%) and S&P 500 (-0.2%), indicating no dominant macro narrative was pushing investors strongly in either direction. In the absence of major catalysts, trading tends to be driven more by individual stock fundamentals and technical setups than broad sentiment. That's why today's decisions leaned on stock-specific technical confirmation rather than a market-wide read.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市表現持平，納指微升0.2%，標普500則微跌0.2%，反映市場缺乏明顯的主導消息面推動方向。在沒有重大催化劑的情況下，交易更多取決於個股基本面及技術走勢，而非整體市場情緒。因此今日的買入決定主要依據個股的技術指標確認，而非大市方向。

trades.reasoning: Full four-signal confirmation (bullish RSI, MACD crossover, price above SMA-20, volume surge) signals genuine institutional buying, not just a neutral-day filler trade.
Same four-signal confluence as BRZE with a different sector (semiconductor equipment), adding diversification while cash sits well above the $500 deployment threshold.
